biotools.summary: The HawkEYE Orbital Fracture Prioritization and Evaluation (HOPE) algorithms are clinical decision-making tools developed to identify orbital fracture patients needing urgent ophthalmology evaluation, improving resource utilization and reducing healthcare costs. An online tool implementing the HOPE+CT algorithm is undergoing prospective validation.
